snippet.title: JAWED - Official Demo Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Demo for JAWED will release on 16 September 2026.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4797910/JAWED/

Jawed is a psychological horror game where you play as Adam, a man muzzled by a life of silent torture since the disappearance of his fiancée. Presented with evidence that she may be alive, Adam must confront their strained relationship and face the only thing that can truly set him free: the truth.

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/reinerthegod.games/
X: https://x.com/RTG_Games_
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@reinerthegod.game

Presskit: https://impress.games/press-kit/beforeyouknow-games/jawed


#JAWED #HorrorGame #PsychologicalHorror #IndieHorror
